sanskrit: kārikā śrī(jñānā)khyātaṃ visarja jñānakārikā(m)sāmprataṃ kathayiṣyāmi yogināṃ yuktakāraṇampañcapañcavinirmukto............varjitamsarvavyā(dhi)vinirmuktaṃ yacca indriyagocara(m)dvādaśāntaṃ kalāśataṃ varṇākṣaravivarjitambrahmā viṣṇustathā rudra īśvaraḥ śiva eva carūpakāyaḥ sadātītaṃ mantratantrāvivarjitamsākulatvaṃ yadā cittaṃ viṣayāsaktacetasāmetaddvandvasamākhyātaṃ saṃsārasya tu nirṇayamyena vijñānamātreṇa muktirbhavati yogināmniścitaṃ niścalaṃ sāmyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ ca nirākulamniścittaṃ cittarahitaṃ kārikājñānamuttamamsarvāśrayavinirmuktaṃ cittāścai(va) nirāśrayamdevo devī tathānyañca dharmādharmavivarjitamāśrayaṃ bandhamityuktaṃ muktiścaiva nirāśrayamviṣayāvasthaṃ yadā cittaṃ dvandvamuktivivarjita(m)kathantaṃ niścalaṃ devi jñātavyaṃ jñānakārikekārikātattvasadbhāvaṃ siddhanāthakulodbhavampṛthivyāpastaṃ tathā yogī vāyurākāśameva casarveṣāṃ vyāpakaḥ śānta vyāptī tasya na vidyatekathitaṃ tattvabhirvastu jñānaratnaṃ sudurlabhamsāttvikantu tṛtīyañca tribhirdharmeṇa lakṣaṇamsāttvikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ jñeyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ sadā sthitamguṇatrayavinirmuktaṃ sadā nirvāṇalakṣaṇamsarvāgnivinayātītamindriyātītamavyayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00024 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cittābhāvavinirmuktaṃ nimittaṃ tattvalaukikamcittādyacintitaṃ jñānamavācyajñānanirṇayamcañcalaṃ bhāvamityuktamacalaṃ muktilakṣaṇamcittātītaṃ yadā cittaṃ niścitamacalaṃ bhavetna yogādhyātacittastu na ca lakṣaṇasādhakamna bahirantamantasthaṃ na cānta ādimadhyagaḥna buddhirna cāhaṃkāro na mana indriyo na cana cintā yastu vijñeyā jñātavya kālaśāsanaḥjñātavyaṃ mokṣasadbhāvaṃ guptabhedaprakāśitamnirvikalpaṃ sadā jñānaṃ kathitaṃ jñānakārikamdhāraṇādharavinyāsacandrasūryāgnimaṇḍalesarve te kalpanā proktaṃ nirvikalpastathānyathāparipūrṇaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ siddhakramavivarjitamna yānti ceha saṃsāre ye sthitā uttamaṃ padampāśadvayavinirūpastu dharmādharmanibandhaneandhapāśaṃ yadā cittaṃ kuto gacchanti yoginaḥtena pāśena baddhastu bhuñjate karmasañcayamdharmādharmau tu dvau yo'sau trailokyasya nibandhanamdharmā caiva adharmā dvau dvividhaṃ parikīrtitamadhyātmajātasadbhāvaṃ yogināmevasaṃsthitaḥādhyātmike caiva dharmādharmasthitiḥ sadādharmādharmakṣaye kṣīṇe mucyate sarvairdhanaiḥ (?)dharmādharmavicāro'yaṃ kathitaṃ jñānakārikaiḥsa cetājñāna na sarvaḥ caitanyaṃ jñānavarjitambhuktitattvaṃ yadā cetaṃ sa cettammuktilakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00024 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yogināṃ yogacintitamāryasaṃjñānavarjitamekaliṅge śmaśāne vā nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu camahodadhitaṭe caiva tripathe vāpi sādhakaḥmālānirmālitā yogī ekākī bhramate sadālayapūjāṣṭakaṃ yattaṃ liṅgantu sa carācarametat kaulikaṃ yalliṅgaṃ na śailahemaraupyajamekaliṅgaṃ samākhyātaṃ śmaśānaṃ kathayāmi tenisvāsasvāsasaṃyuktaṃ śmaśānaṃ parikīrtitamaśarīraṃ yadā tattvaṃ svadehe sā sthitā yadiguhyaṃ tu kathayiṣyāmi guhye sacarācaramguhyāvāsaṃ sthito yogī caryā tasya na ucyatevṛkṣaḥ śarīramityuktaṃ pādādikaraśākhayoḥvṛkṣamūlaṃ tato jñātvā bāhyavṛkṣasya varjitamjayā ca vijayā caiva ajitā cāparājitācatvāraṃ kathitaṃ divyaṃ mahodadhitaṭaḥ śṛṇubinducārusthitā nityaṃ taṭasthaṃ bindumaṇḍalamcandraṃ tyaktvā yadā yāti ādhāraṃ sūryamaṇḍalamgaganamāsthito (?) nityaṃ velā iva mahodadheḥnāsthiraṃ bhavati śvāsaṃ bahisthaṃ manarañjitampravāhaṃ gamanañcaiva gamanāgamanaṃ punaḥgamāgama yathā velā nāsti rañjita kaścit (?)mahodadhitaṭe sthitvā udadhi kathitaṃ tataḥyogināṃ caryasadbhāvaṃ kathitaṃ tattvaṃ viśeṣataḥsattvarajastamaścaiva ekatve tu yathā sthitamtripathaṃ tu samākhyātaṃ nagnantu kathayāmi te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00024 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nagnastu kathitān devān muktakeśantataḥ śṛṇudharmastu naikena pāśaścaiva viśeṣataḥmuktakeśaḥ samākhyāta ānandaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratampānayogāmṛtaṃ divyaṃ yogināṃ samprakīrtitammadirānandamākhyātaṃ nairmālyamālino (?) śṛṇunairmālyamālino yogī yogacaryāṃ karoti saḥasaṃhāyo bhramate dhīraḥ sa ekākīnamucyateetaccaryā samākhyātā viśa ca jñānadhāraka (?)
